concepts.def: Mood expressing hypothetical or polite ideas, formed from the future stem plus imperfect endings.
Used for would-statements: je voudrais, j'irais, il ferait.
Formed with conditional of avoir or etre plus past participle: j'aurais fait.
Literary past tense used for completed actions in written narratives.
Conditional sentence patterns: si + imperfect, conditional present (Si j'avais le temps, je viendrais).

walkthroughs.body_html: Take the future stem (often the infinitive) and add imperfect endings: -ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient. Example: parler + ais = je parlerais (I would speak).
Si j'avais de l'argent, j'achetterais une maison — If I had money, I would buy a house. The si clause uses imperfect; the main clause uses conditional present.
From Camus's L'Etranger: Aujourd'hui, maman est morte uses perfect tense for spoken style. Compare Flaubert: Elle alla a la fenetre — she went to the window (past historic, literary).
